description: Every distinct DesignDocsBundle the live DesignDocs agent has produced, for replay through the real save path. Source: local Mongo mozaiksai.AG2NetworkKnowledge, each wal.jsonl ag2.packet whose event_data.body carries surface_map; context from the channel's metadata.json knobs.context_vars, reduced to the keys the save path reads. Markdown documents are replaced by placeholders. Outputs recorded before entity/tenancy/owner_field became required (21324d46) carry LABELLED defaults in labelled_defaults: the value filled and the rule that chose it; the model did not write them. Outputs from later live runs are appended when a run exposes a save defect, each with its recorded_at: c65f5d0f (2026-09-30) was refused for a plan tier on a subscriptions collection and for a canonical read listed as a custom read; 4da11a24 (2026-10-01, OSS c8b9ea2e) saved an Authentication page at /login, only a credential form, on the app-owned tasks surface.

labelled_default_rules.entity: the owner's primary_entities entry matching the collection name (singular or plural); otherwise the collection name singular in PascalCase
labelled_default_rules.tenancy/owner_field: per_user/user_id when a user_id field is declared; per_workspace/workspace_id when workspace_id is; otherwise app_wide/null
labelled_default_rules.fields.type: the canonical type a recorded type alias names (str -> string, timestamp -> datetime, ...)
